channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: 32,768 cores and 74 petaflops: AMD’s monster new rack for AI agents could be too much for traditional data centers
item.description: AMD's Helion Agentic AI Rack combines high-core-count processors, accelerators, and programmable networking, potentially requiring data centers to upgrade existing infrastructure.

item.title: Teachers are reaching their breaking point in the ChatGPT classroom
item.description: Teachers are venting on TikTok and Reddit about student learning, AI homework, and the growing demands of the classroom.

item.title: Katie Zacharia Was Linked to an AI Rare-Earths Startup. It’s Even Weirder Than It Sounds
item.description: The short-lived White House press secretary was listed as an adviser to a Kristi Noem–linked company that aims to use AI for mining. Both the company and she say she never worked there.

item.title: MapQuest lets you track Flock cameras
item.description: MapQuest adds new surveillance layer, documenting locations of surveillance cameras in your area.

item.title: Porsche’s electric Macan Turbo is an automotive existential crisis
item.description: The 2026 Porsche Macan Turbo EV is a two-row crossover with 630 horsepower and a 100-kilowatt-hour battery.

item.title: Five of the web's biggest data-scraping brands now sit under one $3.6 billion umbrella, and AI agents are the reason why
item.description: Oxylabs, Decodo, Webshare, ScrapingBee, and Honeygain are now one $3.6 billion family called Source, and it says AI agents have quadrupled demand.

item.title: One menu item brought 156,000 new customers to Noodles & Company. Now it’s making a big change
item.description: A limited-time ramen promotion attracted more than 156,000 new guests, prompting the struggling restaurant chain to rethink its permanent menu. Fast casual chain Noodles & Company is about as far from an authentic izakaya as it gets, but it’s confident you’ll want to eat ramen there anyway.

item.title: J’ai remplacé ChatGPT par une IA chinoise gratuite : 11h de vol sans Internet avec un PC Nvidia RTX Spark
item.description: Onze heures de vol entre San Francisco et Paris sans Internet, et un PC portable concurrent du MacBook Pro d'Apple, équipé de la nouvelle puce RTX Spark de Nvidia. J'ai voulu savoir si une IA qui tourne entièrement dans l'ordinateur pouvait remplacer ChatGPT pour mon travail du quotidien. Réponse : pour poser des questions, oui. Pour le reste, pas encore tout à fait, et la batterie a son mot à dire. ...

item.title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky is done with email—and prefers this communication instead
item.description: The Airbnb cofounder and chief executive thinks this email alternative creates a ‘deeper connection’ and ‘doesn’t feel like work to respond.’ Airbnb cofounder and CEO Brian Chesky is not a fan of email.
